scope: Prototype iPhone app and Mac gateway for using lapis agents over Tailscale

hosts.mac: Apple Silicon, macOS 26.5, Xcode 26.6, iOS 26.5 Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro)

checks.name: gateway suite (scripts/tests/test_lapis_remote.py)
checks.result: 8/8 on macOS (four consecutive runs) and on anvil: snapshot decoding, launch fingerprints equal to the pinned launch-spec values, registry reading, admission rules, browser refusal, and against a real session service: list, stream, paste and Enter, resize, a second view taking over, release when the phone leaves, and the desktop attachment receiving replaced

checks.name: iOS UI tests in a headless simulator (scripts/check_ios_remote.py --codex --claude)
checks.result: 6/6: categories and a stopped agent listed; open, type, send and echo; key bar ^U clears a line typed without Enter; wide, emoji, right-to-left and box-drawing output; Settings connection check; another view taking the agent then Open here again; real Codex 0.155.1 (managed mode) and Claude Code 2.1.281 answering a prompt sent from the phone

checks.name: gateway on this Mac's Tailscale address (LaunchAgent)
checks.result: health and agent list answered for the Mac itself; requests without X-Lapis-Client or with an Origin header refused; the simulator app listed the real workspace through the MagicDNS name over HTTP (ts.net transport exception)

checks.name: admission against the real tailnet
checks.result: of 64 peers, none admitted: the owner's two Linux machines, 26 devices of other users (one an iPhone) and 36 tagged devices; only the Mac itself is admitted until the owner's iPhone joins

checks.name: device build (scripts/install_ios_app.py --build-only)
checks.result: signed with the team's wildcard development profile, whose one device is the paired iPhone 17 Pro (Developer Mode on); not installed because the phone was not reachable

limitations: Not yet run on the phone: install, Tailscale reachability over cellular, dictation and the real keyboard
The owner's iPhone was not on the Mac's tailnet under the owner's login on September 23
Opening an agent on the phone retires the desktop's attachment; Reconnect agent takes it back (the desktop's size restore is from code reading, not exercised)
No structured requests, push notifications, or restore without the desktop
Xcode's build service deadlocked on this Mac because kernel pipe memory was exhausted (new pipes held 512 bytes), so the app and tests are compiled directly with swiftc, actool and codesign
